findings.title: Python optimization disables the PNG/JPEG acceptance restriction
findings.detail: The spawned interpreter inherits PYTHONOPTIMIZE. With PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1 or an optimized interpreter wrapper, assert statements are removed. A decodable PPM with correctly bound hash returns PASS, contradicting the PNG/JPEG contract. The existing 14-byte PPM negative fixture independently reproduced this false pass.
findings.requestedChange: Use explicit runtime validation and raise on disallowed format or invalid dimensions instead of assert. Add regression coverage for optimized Python.
findings.reproduce: PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1 node --test --test-name-pattern='official screenshots require complete decoded' tests/platform-load.test.mjs
findings.resolution: Main worker replaced assertions with explicit ValueError checks and added optimized-Python negative/positive coverage. Independent optimized-Python focused rerun passed (1 test), bound to final sourceSha256.

reviewNotes: Hash validation and decoding operate on the same Buffer in one read; the previous unbound second path read is removed.
Decoder execution failure, nonzero exit, and timeout fail closed. Existing documented Python/Pillow and ABYSS_PYTHON toolchain is reused.
PNG/JPEG verify followed by reopen/load covers header-only and truncated payload cases in normal interpreter mode.
RED and normal GREEN focused logs inspected; RED proves the original eight-byte signature false pass and normal GREEN addresses that reproduction.
Synthetic images are clearly marked as synthetic and are not official client, mobile, visual-quality, or release acceptance evidence. Decoding and hashing cannot authenticate screenshot content.
No implementation modifications, Full suite, public-branch operations, GUI use, or official release actions performed.
Final explicit format and dimension conditions remain active with PYTHONOPTIMIZE. Regression restores the parent environment variable in finally. No unresolved findings in reviewed two-file scope.
limits: Targeted/full file and adjacent checks owned by main worker, intentionally not duplicated.
